title.zh: Qivalis, Backed by 37 European Banks, Secures Dutch Central Bank License and Pla
title.en: Qivalis, Backed by 37 European Banks, Secures Dutch Central Bank License and Pla

current_state.zh: Qivalis, a venture backed by 37 major European banks, has obtained an electronic money institution license from the Dutch central bank and plans to issue a MiCA-compliant euro-denominated e-money token distributed through banks, crypto exchanges and payment service providers, with Fireblocks providing digital asset infrastructure.
current_state.en: Qivalis, a venture backed by 37 major European banks, has obtained an electronic money institution license from the Dutch central bank and plans to issue a MiCA-compliant euro-denominated e-money token distributed through banks, crypto exchanges and payment service providers, with Fireblocks providing digital asset infrastructure.
